week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: Sunny. High near 60, with temperatures falling to around 54 in the afternoon. East wind around 3 mph.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: Mostly cloudy, with a high near 61. South southeast wind around 5 mph.

week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: Rain before 5pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 47. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

week.name: Sunday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 52.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Partly sunny, with a high near 55.

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Rain likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 52.
week.night_short: Light Rain Likely then Chance Rain And Snow

week.name: Wednesday
week.detailed: A chance of rain and snow. Partly sunny, with a high near 46.

discussion.key_messages: - Dry conditions with valley inversions persist through the end of the week before valley rain and mountain snow arrive this weekend that will help to mix out the inversions. - Guidance continues to show two more storms next week, but details remain uncertain.

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put 2–8 in. over the next 7 days (middle 4 in.), and they disagree a lot. About 2 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have 2 in. for the week.
